title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Creating Our Gate (class # 36)

chapters.title: Anxiety and control
chapters.about: heart palpitations, desire for control, fragility

chapters.title: Living in the present with Hashem

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses her personal journey and Avodah while caring for her granddaughter, Michal Levona, who is undergoing medical treatment. She explores the concept of personal Geulah by learning to stay in the present, trust in Hashem, and distinguish between facts and personal interpretations when facing difficult situations. Mrs. Tawil also shares practical steps for dealing with triggers by looking inward to understand one's own automatic responses.
questions: How can I find personal redemption in my daily life?
How do I deal with anxiety when I want to be in control?
How can I distinguish between facts and my own interpretations of a situation?
What should I do when I feel triggered by others?
How can I bring Hashem into my daily challenges?
